provider.connectionModes: unchanged: API key (credentials.apiKey, else credentials.accessToken) sent only as the WebSocket upgrade header `Authorization: Key <key>`; an HTTP(S) proxy resolved for https://ws.fal.run is honored, any other proxy is refused (409)
notCovered: OpenAI Realtime (/v1/realtime) bridging and chat-backed text bridges: no source evidence
process-local session registry, artifact store and job/accounting rows (src/lib/fal/realtime.ts, src/lib/db/fal, src/lib/fal/accounting.ts)
the source's prompt-injection guard and Idempotency-Key refusal in src/app/api/v1/fal/run/route.ts

transport.name: http-websocket
transport.endpointSelection: definition.endpoint_id after legacy alias normalization (FAL_LEGACY_ENDPOINTS, the source table verbatim); otherwise it must be owner/app[/subpath], at most 300 chars, no ./.. segments (400 before any key use)
transport.inputSchema: the endpoint's direct HTTP schema (POST /{endpoint_id}, else the only non-/stream POST without {request_id}); never x-fal-realtime; unknown top-level keys refused unless additionalProperties is true
transport.wire: input: one text frame JSON.stringify(input); reply: text {type:start,request_id,status,headers}, raw body frames (text or binary), text {type:end,request_id,status,...}; one invocation at a time (409 while pending)
transport.events: SSE: `event: http-start` with the start frame; event-stream bodies forward each native SSE event, then `event: http-end` with { http }; JSON/text bodies `event: final` with { artifacts, output, http, partial: false }; other bodies `event: final` with { output: { file }, artifacts } via the artifact hook (data URI without one); status >= 400 emits `event: error` with the same shape plus { error }; protocol, transport and deadline failures emit `event: error` with { error, status: FAILED | IDLE_TIMEOUT | SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN } and end the stream
transport.limits: FAL_HTTP_WEBSOCKET_LIMITS: handshake 15 s, frame 32 MiB, send buffer 1 MiB, response body 32 MiB, SSE event 8 MiB, input 8 MiB, invocation 120 s (pass the configured upstream timeout), output high water 1 MiB, queued output 64 MiB, idle 120 s
transport.retries: none: no reconnect, no replay; an invocation without its end when the session stops is reported as SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN and onClose(true)

exports.connect: connectFalHttpWebsocket({ definition, credentials, signal, onClose(uncertain), artifact, proxyUrl, agentFactory, socketFactory, limits }) -> Promise<{ output: ReadableStream<Uint8Array> (SSE), send(input), close(), endpoint, closed, pending }>
exports.realtimeAliases: connectFalRealtimeCanonical, falRealtimePathCanonical, falRealtimeUrlCanonical: the frozen realtime bundle with definition.endpoint_id canonicalized first
exports.metadata: FAL_HTTP_WEBSOCKET_PROVIDER_ID, FAL_HTTP_WEBSOCKET_PROVIDER_ALIASES, FAL_HTTP_WEBSOCKET_TRANSPORT, FAL_HTTP_WEBSOCKET_ORIGIN, FAL_HTTP_WEBSOCKET_PROXY_ORIGIN, FAL_HTTP_WEBSOCKET_LIMITS, FAL_HTTP_WEBSOCKET_PROVIDER_METADATA

for transport "http-websocket": authenticate the client key, resolve the selected fal-ai connection (credentials server-side only), resolve its proxy for https://ws.fal.run (relay proxies refused with 409), obtain the endpoint definition, call connectFalHttpWebsocket with the route's abort signal and limits.invocationTimeoutMs from the configured upstream timeout, pass the artifact store as `artifact`, send the first input, return `output` as text/event-stream with Cache-Control: no-store. Use connectFalRealtimeCanonical (not connectFalRealtime) for transport "realtime" so both transports accept the same endpoint aliases.
follow-up inputs go through the registered session's `send` (validated there; 409 while an invocation is pending, 410 after close); DELETE calls close()

record one dispatched session after the first send returns; onClose(true) or an `error` event with status SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN is an uncertain billable outcome, never retried or replayed; an `error` event with an `http` field is a definite upstream HTTP failure
